# Literal token constructor binding

A child supplies a class literal to an inherited constructor's closed covariant
Class<? extends Bound> slot beside a literal label, fixed context, aliased
references and wide primitive values. The context has a closed generic parent.

Frozen callers observe class resolution without initialization, missing classes,
erroneous initialization, exact exceptions, repeat attempts and field aliases.
Source and SDK layouts must recompile every original class and method with
unchanged Signature, Exceptions, access and Code-presence roles.
